Why Habitly works when other apps don't.

We built Habitly with habit researchers, so every feature helps you keep going on the days you don't feel like it.

✅

One tap to check in

Tick off habits from your home screen or watch. No typing, no menus.

🔥

Streaks that motivate

See your streak grow each day. Miss one? A "skip day" keeps your streak alive.

⏰

Smart reminders

Reminders arrive when you usually do the habit, not at a random time.

📊

Clear progress charts

Weekly and monthly charts show what's working and what needs a nudge.

👯

Friends and challenges

Share a habit with a friend and keep each other on track.

🔒

Private by design

Your data stays on your phone unless you choose to back it up.

Start with two minutes a day.

Big goals fail because they're too big. Habitly helps you start tiny, like one push-up or one page, then grow the habit as it becomes automatic.

  • Ready-made plans for sleep, fitness, reading and money
  • Habits that grow a little each week
  • Works offline, syncs across devices
  • Apple Health and Google Fit support

126,000 five-star reasons.

Questions

What is the best way to build a new habit?

Start very small, do it at the same time each day and track it. Tracking works because seeing your streak makes you less likely to break it. Habitly is designed around these three steps.

Is Habitly free?

Yes. You can track up to five habits for free, forever. Premium adds unlimited habits, charts, challenges and backup.

Does it work on iPhone and Android?

Yes. Habitly works on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Android phones and Wear OS watches.

Can I cancel Premium any time?

Yes. Cancel in your App Store or Google Play settings. You keep Premium until the end of the period you paid for.

Your first streak starts today.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
